anomalies.observed: The MAX31855 thermocouple interface ICs' SO (MISO) pins are tied to net NET0019, which is also the ESP32-C3 USB D- net (GPIO18). The ESP32's SPI MISO pin (GPIO10) is on NET0018, a separate net.
anomalies.expected: All three MAX31855 SO pins should share the common SPI MISO net with the ESP32 GPIO10 (NET0018), per the spec: 'SO (pin 7, tri-state/MISO) are common nets (SCK, SO) tied to all three ICs and to the ESP32 (U1 GPIO5/SCK, GPIO10/SO)'.

evidence.quote: SPI2 on GPIO5/GPIO10 ... sck on GPIO5 and miso on GPIO10
Thermocouples sheet: U1/U4 SO (pin 7) labeled NET0019; MCU sheet: GPIO18/USB_D- (pin 26) labeled NET0019, GPIO10 (pin 15) labeled NET0018

anomalies.impact: The thermocouple MISO data is routed to the USB D- pin instead of the SPI MISO pin, so the firmware cannot read any thermocouple; the shared MISO bus is also shorted to the USB data line, potentially corrupting USB communication.

parsed.summary: The schematic shows the MAX31855 thermocouple SO (MISO) outputs connected to net NET0019 (the ESP32 USB D-/GPIO18 net) rather than the SPI MISO net NET0018 (GPIO10), which would prevent thermocouple reads and bridge the SPI bus onto the USB data line.
